# MDL205 · `duplicate-group`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

The same group is declared twice.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | groups |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | K12 |

## Why

GLib merges the two sections silently: their keys form one group, a key present in both keeps the last value (MDL301). The file then reads as if the second section were separate, which it is not. The fix moves the later section's lines to the end of the first one.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4

[mydumper]
routines=1
```

```text
4:2-4:10 warning MDL205[duplicate-group] [mydumper] is already declared on line 1: GLib merges the two sections
  = The keys of both sections form one group; a key set in both keeps the last value.
  note 1:2-1:10: first declaration
  fix (unsafe): Move these lines to the end of the first section
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4

routines=1
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL205: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL205` on the line above it.
